turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyText: ‎Virtual AgentAgent said: Delivery times depend on the shipping method you selected: - Standard shipping to the 48 contiguous United States usually takes 4–8 business days after your order ships. - Priority shipping takes 3–4 business days. - Express shipping takes 1–2 business days. Shipping timeframes begin once your order is shipped and you receive your shipping confirmation email. If you need help checking your specific order status, just let me know your order number or the email you used to place the order!DisclosureBy using this chat, you are accepting and consenting to the practices described in our privacy policy.Agent saidHi! Welcome to Thirdlove. I'm Barbra, your AI Fit Stylist. We're so glad you're here. How can we help you feel your best today?You saidI placed an order a few days ago and still have no tracking, where is it?Agent saidI’d be happy to help you check on your order status. To get started, could you please provide your order number or the email address you used to place the order? This will help me look up your order and provide the most accurate tracking information.You saidHow long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?Agent saidOrders are usually processed and shipped within 2 business days after being placed, Monday through Friday (excluding holidays). Once your order ships, you'll receive a shipping confirmation email with your tracking number. Sometimes it can take up to 2 business days after the shipping confirmation for tracking activity to appear.If you haven’t received tracking yet, your order may still be processing or preparing for shipment.
